offer.name: KnownFix
offer.description: Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

backend.note: Durably hosted on Deno Deploy (KV-backed double-spend guard). Stable, always-on, no rotation. The backend serves its own /.well-known/farebox.json and a remote MCP server at /mcp.

settlement.network: base-sepolia (TESTNET — currency has no value; faucet ETH works)
settlement.route: GET {backend}/fix/{id} -> 402; pay payTo on chain 84532; retry with proofHeader -> 200
rules: only purchase when backend.status is live-durable/live-ephemeral AND backend.url is non-null
one mined payment of >= perFixWei to payTo redeems exactly one fix; a hash never redeems twice
